Preserve existing security, attribution, measurement, and failure-containment work. Allow one bounded public read-only inspection to close the specific evidence gap around observable positioning, disclosures, conversion paths, and launch-scope unknowns; do not request duplicate telemetry or alter production.

Owner concern: revenue, ROI, margin, payback, causal lift, and launch readiness remain unsupported because attribution is partial, revenue and cost periods are misaligned, operations and security sweeps have no results, and the site has low or absent telemetry. Keep all production, monetization, launch, and requeue decisions deferred until existing gates clear.

Reject all new implementation queue work this cycle. No candidate is unblocked: existing queue, failure-repair, release, measurement, attribution, ownership, and security gates remain uncleared. Revenue, ROI, margin, payback, causal lift, and budget capacity remain unknown; the $4.92 provider aggregate is unattributed. Continue only existing repair, reconciliation, legal, security, and measurement work. Preserve the bounded elevatorfriends.com public inspection as read-only evidence work only; do not route its report as implementation. Owner concern: external permission outreach remains unsent pending human-counsel review.
